text.en: A Sangam poem sings of the cosmos and its creation.

Pariyaadal is one of the eight Sangam anthologies (எட்டுத்தொகை) and is sung in a special mixed metre called paripadal. The poem in the textbook describes the beginnings of the universe and natural features in a poetic way.
It shows that ancient Tamils had a sense of the origin and order of nature. It is valued for its music and its picture of nature.
Terms: பரிபாடல், எட்டுத்தொகை, சங்க இலக்கியம் and இசைப்பாடல் (musical poem).
